narrative: The draft applies one mandatory public catastrophic-risk framework uniformly to every over-threshold developer and funds a federal body to write the standardizing guidelines. That is exactly the structural force toward a shared quantitative-harm shape this thesis names: separately-built lab frameworks now have a common template and a strong incentive to converge ahead of any vote.
remaining_gap: It is a regulatory blueprint, not yet revised lab frameworks; no over-threshold developer has actually re-published toward the common shape.
